observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that a cached key remains null after the background refresh deadline expires, while no reload is triggered.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the LazyLoader correctly preserves a null cached entry past the refresh window without unnecessary reloads.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting cache eviction behavior when the loader omits keys, including null entries, against maxSize.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that cached null entries count against the cache size limit and trigger eviction when maxSize is reached.

observations.behavior: Changes the return type of the private load() method and its internal keyPromises array from Promise<LazyLoaderMap<T>> to Promise<void>.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the return value from the batched loading operation, relying instead on setValues to populate the cache, while callers read from cache directly.
